posts.en:
TMCRA-Agent-Memory is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Technical-preview local graph memory for DSH and Codex: recalls owner-global and current-project evidence before each turn, writes USER and ASSISTANT records separately, and preserves project, session, actor, and source provenance for a visual atlas and cited knowledge pages.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ef921c770cc37dab392a.html
